Physiotherapy that gets you moving again

We are a small, independent clinic on Marsh Lane. Whether it is a running injury, a stiff back or recovery after surgery, we will find out what is wrong and give you a plan you can follow at home

What we treat

  • Back and neck pain
  • Sports injuries, from ankles to shoulders
  • Recovery after an operation

Not sure if we can help? Send us a message and Sarah will call you back the same day.
